title: ServiceNow, Inc. (NYSE:NOW) Q1 2024 Earnings Call Transcript
summary: ServiceNow reported outstanding Q1 2024 results, outperforming guidance across all top-line and profitability metrics, driven by strong adoption of its GenAI offerings and strategic partnerships. The company's subscription revenue grew by 24.5% year-over-year in constant currency, and its GenAI product, Pro Plus, is the fastest-selling offering in company history. ServiceNow raised its 2024 top-line outlook despite FX headwinds, emphasizing its strong market position and the increasing relevance of its AI platform for business transformation.

title: Conduent and Voya Financial adopt Oracle Database@Azure for cloud migration
summary: Conduent and Voya Financial have successfully migrated their database operations to Oracle Database@Azure, a service co-locating Oracle's Exadata servers within Microsoft Azure data centers. This move has enabled improved application performance, real-time transaction processing, and streamlined IT infrastructure management for both companies. Additionally, Oracle announced the availability of Nvidia H100 and A100 GPUs in its US Government Cloud region, offering advanced AI capabilities for government agencies.

title: The Estée Lauder Companies and Microsoft increase collaboration to power prestige beauty with generative AI
summary: The Estée Lauder Companies (ELC) and Microsoft have expanded their global strategic relationship by creating an AI Innovation Lab. This collaboration aims to leverage Microsoft's Azure OpenAI Service to empower ELC's prestige beauty brands, enhance consumer connections, accelerate market entry with local relevance, and drive faster product innovation. The initiative deepens a partnership that began in 2017, which previously included the development of ELC's Voice-Enabled Makeup Assistant for visually impaired users.

title: Microsoft reports 51% rise in Q3 gaming revenue thanks to Activision Blizzard, but console sales plummet
summary: Microsoft announced a significant 51% increase in its Q3 gaming revenue, primarily attributed to the acquisition of Activision Blizzard and strong performance of Call of Duty titles. However, this growth was contrasted by a 31% drop in Xbox hardware revenue due to lower console sales. The company noted record game streaming hours and console usage, with expectations for continued gaming segment growth in Q4, despite anticipated declines in hardware revenue.

title: CEOs of Microsoft, Nvidia and other tech giants join federal AI advisory board
summary: A federal AI advisory board has been established, comprising prominent tech executives, academics, and civil rights leaders, including CEOs from Microsoft, Nvidia, and OpenAI. Led by Secretary of Homeland Security Alejandro Mayorkas, the board will advise the Department of Homeland Security on the safe application of AI in critical infrastructure and issue recommendations for organizations like power grid operators and manufacturers. This initiative stems from President Biden's executive order on AI, which also mandates data sharing on new AI models' safety with the government.

title: Microsoft leaves office space in Morrisville as company moves to consolidate leases
summary: Microsoft has reduced its office footprint in Morrisville, North Carolina, by ending a lease for approximately 39,000 square feet and seeking to sublease an additional 20,000 square feet. This move is part of a broader company strategy to consolidate office leases and create higher density workspaces. The change reflects a trend among major tech companies to reduce office space post-pandemic, contributing to high office vacancy rates in the Raleigh-Durham area.

title: Why I Just Added This Ultra-High-Yield Dividend ETF to My Retirement Account
summary: The author recently added the JPMorgan Nasdaq Equity Premium Income ETF (JEPQ) to their retirement account, aiming for consistent passive income and price appreciation with lower volatility. JEPQ offers a high dividend yield (9.2% over 30 days, 10.8% over 12 months) through a strategy of holding a high-quality equity portfolio and selling out-of-the-money call options on the Nasdaq-100 index. This approach is designed to generate monthly income and provide relatively steady returns, making it an attractive investment for retirement planning.

title: Triller Looks to Become a TikTok Competitor
summary: Triller Corp. is being sold in an all-stock transaction to AGBA Group Holding Ltd., aiming to position itself as a major TikTok competitor. The merger, valuing the combined company at $4 billion, will also facilitate Triller's long-sought goal of going public. Triller plans to maintain its Hollywood presence, develop a new creator-focused headquarters in Los Angeles, and expand its team.

title: From Washing Machine To TV And Fridges, Reliance Is Coming For India’s Electronic Market With WYZR
summary: Reliance Industries Limited (RIL) is entering the Indian consumer electronics market with its new brand, Wyzr, aiming to compete with established players like Samsung and LG. Wyzr's website is live, initially offering air coolers, with plans to expand into a wide range of home appliances. RIL is reportedly finalizing production agreements with Mirc Electronics and Dixon Technologies, with Wyzr products expected to be affordably priced and distributed through Reliance Retail and other channels.

title: Korean Air validates its UAM system in world first operations demonstration
summary: Korean Air has successfully conducted the world's first comprehensive urban air mobility (UAM) operations demonstration, collaborating with partners like Hyundai Motor Company and Incheon International Airport Corporation. Over five weeks, the airline validated its UAM Operation Control System and Traffic Management System, utilizing a 5G aviation communication network to link e-VTOL aircraft with operating systems. This demonstration involved 10 different scenarios to test system functionality and performance, marking a significant step towards developing Korea's UAM ecosystem.

title: Microsoft Korea hosts AI Tour in Seoul illuminating the future of AI technology
summary: Microsoft Korea hosted the ‘Microsoft AI Tour in Seoul’ to provide insights into AI technology for developers and organizations, emphasizing AI's role in business transformation and new opportunities. The event highlighted Microsoft's commitment to supporting the developer community, introducing the Korean version of Copilot for Microsoft 365, and showcasing successful AI implementations by companies like LG Electronics and SK Innovation using Azure OpenAI Service. Microsoft also announced its AI Odyssey initiative and collaboration with the Seoul Metropolitan Government to strengthen AI training and entrepreneurship.

title: After Earnings, Is Meta Stock a Buy, a Sell, or Fairly Valued?
summary: Morningstar assessed Meta Platforms' stock following its Q1 earnings report, maintaining a "Wide" economic moat rating but deeming the stock overvalued with a 2-star rating and a $400 fair value estimate. The article highlights Meta's strong core advertising business, driven by AI investments, but also points out the high uncertainty due to speculative AI initiatives and competition. Investors are advised to be comfortable with Meta's aggressive investment in new technologies, as regulatory risks and dependence on online advertising remain significant concerns.

title: 9 Top Data Classification Tools
summary: This article reviews nine top data classification tools designed to automate the process of finding, classifying, governing, and masking sensitive data. It details features, compliance support, and use cases for each tool, including Varonis, Fortra Digital Guardian, ManageEngine DataSecurity Plus, Satori, Imperva, OneTrust, Forcepoint, Atlan, and Securiti. The article emphasizes that these tools simplify compliance with various privacy regulations and enhance data security.

title: Microsoft to invest $1.7 billion in cloud, AI in Indonesia, CEO says
summary: Microsoft announced a $1.7 billion investment over the next four years to expand cloud services and artificial intelligence in Indonesia, including building data centers. CEO Satya Nadella is on a Southeast Asian tour to promote the company's generative AI technology. Microsoft also plans to train 2.5 million people in Southeast Asia in AI use by 2025, with 840,000 specifically in Indonesia.

title: Kevin Johnson, Former CEO of Starbucks and Juniper Networks, Appointed to Recogni Board of Directors
summary: Recogni, Inc., a leader in Generative AI inference technology, has appointed Kevin Johnson, former CEO of Starbucks and Juniper Networks, as an independent board member and investor. Johnson's extensive leadership experience and strategic insights in enterprise and cloud domains are expected to significantly contribute to Recogni's growth, particularly as it broadens AI's accessibility and market reach. He expressed confidence in Recogni's intellectual property and its potential to establish a new performance paradigm for AI inference engines.

title: As You Sow Calls Out Big Tech for $5 Billion Loss in 401(k) Returns
summary: A report by the non-profit As You Sow and researchers at the University of Waterloo indicates that over two million employees of 12 tech companies missed out on $5.1 billion in retirement savings. This loss is attributed to the companies' 401(k) plans not adopting sustainable investing strategies, specifically by retaining investments in fossil fuels. The study found a significant difference in 10-year returns for portfolios without fossil fuels, leading As You Sow to accuse these companies of greenwashing and urge them to offer sustainable investment options.

title: Nvidia Could Help This Stock-Split ETF Turn $200,000 Into $1 Million in 10 Years
summary: The iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX), which holds significant stakes in leading chip companies like Nvidia, recently completed a 3-for-1 stock split, making it more accessible to investors. Driven by the booming artificial intelligence sector and the need to upgrade data center infrastructure, the ETF has shown impressive historical returns. With continued growth in AI, the SOXX ETF has the potential to turn a $200,000 investment into $1 million within a decade, even with moderate annual returns.

title: 3 ETFs to Buy When the Market Gets Crazy
summary: This article recommends three ETFs: Vanguard Dividend Appreciation ETF (VIG), Utilities Select Sector SPDR Fund (XLU), and iShares US Consumer Staples ETF (IYK), as strategic investments during volatile market conditions. These ETFs offer diversification, downside mitigation, and exposure to stable sectors like dividend-growing companies, utilities, and consumer staples, providing a degree of security and predictable revenue streams.

title: RBRK Stock: Rubrik Share Price Flat Post-IPO
summary: Rubrik's share price saw a flat trend following its IPO on April 25, despite an initial strong debut where new orders heavily oversubscribed available shares. The data security software company, valued at $6.6 billion, faces the challenge of not yet posting a profit, though its CEO remains optimistic about a path to profitability in the AI-dominated cybersecurity niche. This IPO is part of a broader recovery in the US IPO market, with companies like Reddit experiencing mixed results post-debut, while Ibotta has shown positive performance.

title: Brookfield reaches framework deal to sell renewable power to Microsoft for data centres
summary: Brookfield Asset Management and Microsoft Corp. have struck a framework agreement for Brookfield to provide 10.5 gigawatts of renewable power to Microsoft's data centres in the U.S. and Europe between 2026 and 2030. This deal addresses Microsoft's burgeoning AI and cloud computing power needs with cleaner energy and helps it work towards its goal of matching total electricity consumption with zero-carbon energy purchases by 2030. While financial terms are undisclosed, the agreement significantly de-risks Brookfield's substantial renewable energy project pipeline and provides Microsoft with a more dependable supply of clean energy.

title: Franklin Templeton wants to transform the industry through Microsoft AI partnership
summary: Franklin Templeton is collaborating with Microsoft to develop an advanced financial AI platform using Microsoft Azure AI services. This partnership aims to integrate AI into Franklin Templeton's operations to enhance digital transformation, personalize client support, and improve sales and marketing efforts. The platform will utilize a multi-layer intelligence approach, combining structured data and contextual financial information to offer advanced capabilities beyond typical AI limitations.

title: Nevada gaming regulators recommend license for media mogul Barry Diller
summary: Nevada gaming regulators have recommended an unlimited license for billionaire investor Barry Diller, two years after he received a limited license due to an insider trading investigation. The SEC recently closed its investigation into Diller's stock sale without recommending enforcement action. The Nevada Gaming Commission will make the final decision on May 16, with some regulators expressing concerns about the ongoing Department of Justice case.

title: Positive Tech Earnings Could Accelerate This Momentum ETF
summary: Positive tech earnings, especially from "Magnificent Seven" companies, are expected to fuel the Invesco S&P 500 Momentum ETF (SPMO) after a challenging April. The ETF focuses on large-cap growth names with a high momentum score, and strong tech performance could drive further gains for the S&P 500. Additionally, disinflation data and the Federal Reserve's monetary policy decisions will play a crucial role in sustaining market momentum.

title: AMD AI chip revenue forecast fails to impress, shares dive 7%
summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) shares fell by about 7% after its forecast for AI chip sales for 2024, at roughly $4 billion, failed to meet Wall Street's expectations, despite being an increase from its prior estimate. The company faces stiff competition from Nvidia in the booming AI server semiconductor market and is experiencing weakness in traditional server, gaming, and embedded segments. AMD also reported first-quarter revenue that slightly beat estimates and provided a second-quarter revenue forecast in line with analyst expectations.

title: Brookfield, Microsoft ink largest-ever corporate clean energy deal for 10.5 GW
summary: Microsoft will purchase over 10.5 GW of clean energy projects from Brookfield Asset Management and Brookfield Renewable, marking the largest-ever corporate clean energy deal. This agreement will provide wind, solar, and other carbon-free energy technologies to Microsoft's operations in the U.S. and Europe between 2026 and 2030, with potential for further expansion. The deal is nearly eight times larger than any previous single corporate power purchase agreement.

title: Microsoft Signs Largest-Ever Corporate Renewable Energy Deal with Brookfield
summary: Microsoft and Brookfield Asset Management announced a new 5-year global renewable energy framework agreement, which is the largest-ever corporate clean energy purchase deal. The agreement involves the development of over 10.5 GW of new clean energy capacity in the U.S. and Europe, primarily focusing on solar and wind. This partnership supports Microsoft's goal to achieve 100% of its electricity consumption matched by zero-carbon energy purchases by 2030 and aids in decarbonizing the grid within the cloud industry.

title: Estee Lauder teams up with Microsoft on generative AI for R&D and marketing
summary: Estee Lauder and Microsoft are collaborating on a generative AI project through their AI Innovation Lab to enhance speed to market and consumer connections for Estee Lauder's beauty brands. The initiative involves creating an internal AI chatbot for marketing campaign development and utilizing the technology for faster product development and research. This partnership builds on Estee Lauder's prior AI ventures, including a mobile app for visually impaired users and projects with Google Cloud for consumer sentiment analysis and R&D.

title: COPYRIGHT NEWS: More newspapers sue Microsoft, OpenAI for alleged copyright infringement
summary: Wolters Kluwer reports that more newspapers are suing Microsoft and OpenAI, accusing them of copyright infringement. This indicates a growing legal battle between content creators and AI companies over the use of published materials for training AI models.

title: Unpacking AI governance to shape digital transformation
summary: This article emphasizes the importance of AI governance for businesses looking to integrate AI safely and effectively. It suggests that developing a strong AI governance framework, understanding AI's practical applications, and training employees are crucial steps for successful digital transformation. Microsoft shares its own responsible AI practices and encourages businesses to evaluate real-life AI use cases to identify how the technology can drive growth and innovation.

title: Microsoft Publishes Guide To Better Corporate CDR Claims
summary: Microsoft has released a comprehensive guide to help corporations make more effective and impactful carbon dioxide removal (CDR) claims. The guide aims to align corporate carbon claims with government regulations to streamline emission reduction efforts and achieve sustainability goals. Microsoft emphasizes transparency in disclosing the origins and countries of carbon credits to bridge the gap between corporate inventories and national records, ultimately boosting funding and advancement of CDR initiatives.

title: Breaking down Microsoft’s pivot to placing cybersecurity as a top priority
summary: Microsoft is making cybersecurity its top priority following criticism from the US Department of Homeland Security. CEO Satya Nadella and EVP Charlie Bell outlined a new Secure Future Initiative based on six pillars focusing on internal corporate systems, with accountability tied to senior leadership compensation. The author praises the messaging and strategic shift, noting that while Microsoft has challenges stemming from accrued security debt and past practices, the new commitment has the potential to redefine its offerings as the most secure solutions available, ultimately benefiting all customers.

title: Entergy CEO shares bold vision for improving stakeholder outcomes at annual meeting
summary: Entergy CEO Drew Marsh outlined a bold vision at the company's 75th annual meeting, focusing on supporting customer growth, addressing cleaner energy demands, and enhancing reliability and resilience while maintaining affordability. He highlighted significant achievements in 2023, including strong industrial sales, increased renewable energy investments, and crucial resilience project approvals in New Orleans and Louisiana. Marsh emphasized the economic development opportunities, such as Amazon Web Services' $10 billion investment in Mississippi, and the company's steady financial growth, including exceeding earnings expectations and increasing dividends.

title: Genpact partners with Microsoft for finance transformation across enterprises
summary: Genpact has announced a strategic collaboration with Microsoft to drive modern finance transformation across enterprises globally. This partnership leverages Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service and Genpact's expertise to accelerate decision-making in finance organizations through data, technology, and AI. The collaboration aims to enhance efficiency, improve experiences, and has already shown significant improvements in Genpact's own finance functions, such as vendor management automation and customer collections.

title: Data Center Market size to record USD 329.82 billion growth from 2023-2027, Implementation of AI in data centers is one of the key market trends, Technavio
summary: The global data center market is projected to grow by USD 329.82 billion from 2023 to 2027, driven by a 12.73% CAGR, with the implementation of AI in data centers being a primary trend. AI enhances energy efficiency, optimizes systems, and accelerates decision-making, leading to benefits like reduced infrastructure costs and faster deployment. Despite growth, the market faces challenges like cybersecurity issues and the need to comply with stringent data protection regulations.

title: Docusign buys Lexion, creator of an AI-powered contract management platform, for $165M
summary: Docusign has acquired Lexion, an AI-powered contract management platform, for $165 million in an all-cash deal. This acquisition aims to enhance Docusign's new Intelligent Agreement Management platform by integrating Lexion's AI capabilities for contract creation, analysis, and insights. The deal comes as Docusign itself has been the subject of acquisition rumors.

title: Transforming Indonesian Businesses for an AI-Powered Future: Success Stories from BUMA, DANA, and TELKOM
summary: This article showcases how Indonesian companies BUMA, DANA, and TELKOM are leveraging AI, specifically Microsoft's Copilot and Azure OpenAI Service, to enhance efficiency, productivity, and customer satisfaction. Their successful integration of AI tools highlights the technology's potential to significantly boost Indonesia's economic growth, with projections estimating an almost US$366 billion addition to GDP by 2030. The case studies demonstrate AI's application in diverse sectors, from mining and financial services to telecommunications, underscoring its transformative impact across the Indonesian business landscape.

title: An AI Bubble? Know Which AI ETFs Stand Out
summary: This article discusses the potential for an "AI bubble" and highlights two AI-focused ETFs, WTAI and WISE, that offer distinct investment strategies. WTAI uses an equally weighted approach to global AI stocks, screening for ESG aspects and balancing mega-cap tech with smaller firms. WISE complements large AI players with semiconductor firms, utilizing proprietary algorithms to identify companies generating significant revenue from AI, data, or natural language processing.

title: 2 Great Large-Cap ETFs
summary: This article recommends two large-cap ETFs, T. Rowe Price Capital Appreciation Equity ETF (TCAF) and Vanguard High Dividend Yield ETF (VYM), as excellent portfolio building blocks. Russel Kinnel explains his rationale for owning both, highlighting TCAF's skilled manager David Giroux and VYM's value tilt for diversification.

title: Brookfield’s Renewable Solutions to Power Data Centers
summary: Brookfield Renewable Partners LP is strategically positioning itself to meet the increasing electricity demand from data centers, leveraging its development pipeline and acquisition strategy to provide continuous power solutions. The company's Renewable Power & Transition arm manages a vast portfolio of renewable energy assets and has partnered with Microsoft Corp. to supply renewable energy from 2026 to 2030, expecting to generate well over 10 GW annually. This initiative addresses the AI boom's projected 70% annual increase in data center power demand through 2027 and the significant rise in global carbon emissions.

title: ServiceNow to integrate Now Assist with Microsoft Copilot
summary: ServiceNow announced an integration between its generative AI bot, Now Assist, and Microsoft Copilot, creating a unified AI experience for enterprise users. This partnership, revealed at ServiceNow's Knowledge 2024 conference, will allow Copilot to leverage Now Assist's workflows for productivity tasks within Microsoft 365, including handling employee requests from Microsoft Teams. The integration, expected in Fall, aims to reduce context switching and enhance enterprise productivity.

title: EA studios 'hunger' to start using generative AI 'as quickly as possible,' says CEO
summary: EA CEO Andrew Wilson states that the company's studios are eager to implement generative AI to increase efficiency and build more expansive games. He believes over 50% of development processes will be positively impacted, with the goal to create bigger worlds and more complex storylines within five years by leveraging EA's proprietary data.

title: Microsoft announces $3.3 billion investment in Wisconsin to spur artificial intelligence innovation and economic growth
summary: Microsoft announced a $3.3 billion investment package in Southeast Wisconsin to boost AI-powered economic activity, innovation, and job creation. This initiative includes a new datacenter campus, the country's first manufacturing-focused AI co-innovation lab, and an AI skilling program for over 100,000 residents. The investment aims to reinforce Wisconsin's position as a manufacturing and innovation hub, supported by partnerships with educational institutions and local community programs.

title: Arrow PC Network Hosted Impact 2024 to Shape Brighter Future Through Collaboration & Innovation
summary: Arrow PC Network's Impact 2024 event, held in Jim Corbett and sponsored by industry leaders like Dell and AWS, focused on fostering positive change and innovation within the IT sector. The event, themed around making a lasting impact, featured keynote speeches, practical strategies for business transformation, and insights into AI/ML, cybersecurity, and cloud computing. It also included networking opportunities and activities for attendees and their families, emphasizing community alongside professional development.

title: Adobe's Acrobat AI Assistant Is Available and Could Help Company Compete
summary: Adobe has launched its Acrobat AI Assistant, available to individual and enterprise users via a paid add-on subscription. This move positions Adobe to better compete with other big tech companies like Microsoft and Google in the artificial intelligence market. The AI Assistant aims to enhance document productivity and generate insights, contributing to Adobe's AI monetization strategy.

title: Kyndryl says return to profitability is ahead of schedule as it delivers strong earnings results
summary: Kyndryl Holdings Inc. reported strong fiscal 2024 fourth-quarter results, beating analysts' expectations for earnings and revenue and signaling an earlier-than-anticipated return to profitability. The company posted a significant improvement in its net loss and provided optimistic guidance for fiscal 2025, driven by growth in its Kyndryl Consult business and strategic partnerships. Kyndryl's transition from transformation to growth, focusing on higher-margin services and cloud infrastructure partnerships, has positioned it ahead of its financial targets.

title: AI-hungry tech giants can’t build fast enough. They’ll need Bitcoin miners to help
summary: Bitcoin miners like Hive and Hut 8 are diversifying their operations by building AI fleets and leasing computing power to tech giants, creating a new, more predictable revenue stream independent of Bitcoin's volatile price. This strategy allows miners to capitalize on the high demand for computational power needed for AI development, with some firms aiming for significant annual revenue from AI services. The move also highlights the increasing competition between the Bitcoin mining and AI industries for processing chips and suitable land sites with low electricity costs, potentially leading to acquisitions of mining companies by big tech firms.

title: Roundhill Reaches $1B AUM Milestone
summary: Roundhill Investments, a themes-focused ETF issuer, announced it has reached $1 billion in assets under management, driven largely by the rapid growth of its A.I.-focused funds. This milestone comes shortly after Dave Mazza assumed the CEO role, with the firm emphasizing a strategy of quality over quantity in new fund launches and exploring diversification into new themes like weight loss medications. Key contributors to this growth include the Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGS) and the Roundhill Generative AI and Technology ETF (CHAT).

title: Digital Map Market Size, Share with Focus on Emerging Technologies, Top Countries Data, Top Key Players Update, and Forecast 2029
summary: The digital map market is projected to grow at a CAGR of 11.1% from USD 28.3 billion in 2024 to USD 47.8 billion by 2029, driven by increased organizational need for efficiency and scalability. The routing and navigation data segment is expected to hold the largest market share, with the Asia Pacific region experiencing the highest growth rates due to technological advancements and smartphone adoption. Key players like Google, Apple, and Nearmap are adopting various growth strategies to expand their market presence.

title: Tech Stock Dividends Are Changing the Face of Dividend Growth Investing
summary: The article discusses how major tech companies like Alphabet, Meta, and Salesforce are starting to pay dividends, shifting the landscape of dividend growth investing. This trend is increasing the representation of tech stocks in dividend growth strategies, potentially improving market correlation but also lowering overall portfolio diversification. While tech dividends are generally low-yielding, their potential for future growth alongside earnings is attractive to investors focused on long-term dividend appreciation.

title: Introducing The Forrester Reference IT Capability Map
summary: Forrester has published a new Reference IT Capability Map, which provides a comprehensive framework for defining and delivering IT and digital systems, both individually and at a portfolio level. This map aims to help organizations assess their digital and IT capabilities, identifying gaps or redundancies. The framework, developed through extensive collaboration, offers a "Level 2" view with 20 capabilities grouped into seven major areas, with a more detailed "Level 3" version providing about 75 subcapabilities.

title: Corporations buy into sustainable fuel certificates to address air travel emissions
summary: Corporations are increasingly purchasing sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) certificates to offset their Scope 3 emissions from business travel, aiming to reduce their carbon footprint and boost demand for lower-carbon fuels. Boston Consulting Group, Netflix, Meta, Microsoft, and others have invested significantly in these certificates, which critics warn could lead to greenwashing. Experts advise companies to understand the early market risks, work with established players, and not use SAF certificates as an excuse for more flights.

title: WEC Energy's Gale Klappa: Microsoft building on foundation set by Foxconn, Power the Future
summary: Retiring WEC Energy executive chair Gale Klappa attributes Microsoft's recent multibillion-dollar investment in Racine County to the region's prior experience with Foxconn. He indicates that the foundation laid by the Foxconn project and the Power the Future initiative played a crucial role in attracting Microsoft's attention. This suggests a precedent set by previous large-scale developments that paved the way for future investment in the area.

title: VTEX brings the power of digital commerce innovation to Barcelona, setting the trend of an industry estimated to exceed USD 750 bln by 2027
summary: VTEX, a leading composable commerce platform, is organizing its "VTEX Connect Europe" event in Barcelona on June 7th to convene digital commerce specialists. The event aims to provide industry professionals with specialized content, digital solutions, and market insights, as the global e-commerce market is projected to exceed USD 750 billion by 2027. World-class speakers from companies like LinkedIn, NASA, and Whirlpool will share insights on innovation, consumer behavior, and customer-centric strategies.

title: Murray State Welcomes Record Turnout For Security Matters 2024
summary: Murray State University's Cyber Education and Research Center hosted its annual Security Matters Conference and Patterns of Distinction Awards Luncheon, drawing a record-breaking nearly 300 attendees. The event featured industry professionals, awarded scholarships, and recognized significant contributions to cybersecurity, including a $10 million state budget appropriation for the Cyber Education and Research Center. Murray State's Cybersecurity and Network Management program was also noted for placing in the top 10 nationally among 400 institutions.

title: Cisco adds AI features to AppDynamics On-Premises
summary: Cisco has introduced new AI-driven capabilities to its AppDynamics On-Premises observability platform, including a new virtual appliance designed for anomaly detection, root cause analysis, application security, and SAP monitoring. These enhancements aim to help customers more quickly identify and resolve performance and security issues across their application stack. The platform now also supports deployment on AWS and Microsoft Azure, offering greater flexibility for managing observability solutions.

title: Australia Pacific Airports Corporation elevates operations with Dynamics 365 to keep the pace of modern travel
summary: Australia Pacific Airports Corporation (APAC), owner and operator of Melbourne Airport and Launceston Airport, has implemented Microsoft Dynamics 365 to modernize its operations and unify disparate systems. This digital transformation has led to significant improvements in asset management, property management, marketing communications, and overall operational efficiency since its full deployment in November 2022. The successful integration of Dynamics 365 supports APAC's growth strategy and enhances experiences for passengers, customers, and staff.

title: Goldman Sachs S&P 500 Premium Income ETF (GPIX) Holdings
summary: This article details the holdings of the Goldman Sachs S&P 500 Premium Income ETF (GPIX), showing its top 10 holdings with NVIDIA, Apple, and Alphabet as the largest. It also outlines the sector weightings, with Technology representing the highest percentage. The ETF aims to invest at least 80% of its assets in companies included in its benchmark.

title: Google Cloud Is the World's Hottest Major Cloud Vendor; Oracle, ServiceNow Tied for Second
summary: Google Cloud leads the Cloud Wars Top 10 as the fastest-growing major cloud vendor, with its Q1 growth accelerating to 28%. Oracle and ServiceNow are tied for second place, each increasing their cloud revenue by 25%. The article provides a detailed breakdown of the growth rates and cloud revenues for the top cloud companies, highlighting significant trends and challenges for each.

title: 9 Top RPA Companies: Front Runners in Smart Technology
summary: This article identifies and evaluates the top nine Robotic Process Automation (RPA) companies in 2024, focusing on their business status, RPA solutions, pricing, and customer support. Key players like Microsoft, UiPath, and Automation Anywhere are highlighted for their distinct strengths, such as integration capabilities, data reconciliation, and anti-money laundering solutions. The analysis provides a comprehensive comparison to help businesses select the most suitable RPA provider for their specific needs, emphasizing factors like financial stability and strategic decisions.

title: Alternatives to LinkedIn Ads: Best Advertising Platforms
summary: This article explores alternatives to LinkedIn Ads for marketers, highlighting its pros (precise B2B targeting) and cons (high cost, lower engagement time). It details five alternative platforms: Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, X (Twitter), Quora, and Taboola. The piece emphasizes diversifying advertising strategies across various platforms to maximize ROI and reach different audience segments.

title: Barings Supports Zabel’s New Platform Investment in SVI International
summary: Barings has provided financing support to The Zabel Companies for its acquisition of SVI International, serving as lead agent, sole lender, and minority equity investor. SVI International is a leading supplier of aftermarket repair parts for automotive equipment. This transaction enhances Barings' Global Private Finance platform and leverages Zabel's experience in aftermarket parts for accelerated growth.

title: CaLLM, Cool and Connected: Cerence Uses Generative AI to Transform the In-Car Experience
summary: Cerence is collaborating with NVIDIA to integrate generative AI into automotive experiences, launching the Cerence Automotive Large Language Model (CaLLM) as the foundation for its next-gen in-car computing platform. This platform, running on NVIDIA DRIVE, aims to redefine in-car interaction by enabling vehicles to comprehend and respond to human language with remarkable accuracy. Cerence leverages NVIDIA DGX Cloud on Microsoft Azure to train its AI models, aspiring to transform vehicles into intelligent companions and make driving a personalized, connected, and safer experience.

title: Constellation Energy to Pursue New Nuclear Power for Data Centers
summary: Constellation Energy, the largest nuclear power operator in the U.S., is exploring building new nuclear capacity at its existing reactor sites to power the increasing demand from data centers. This initiative addresses the significant power consumption of data centers, especially with the rise of AI, and aligns with sustainability goals by providing reliable, low-carbon energy. The company is in advanced talks with major tech firms and plans to perform due diligence for projects targeting 2026-2028.

title: Intelligent data infrastructure: NetApp's latest trends and strategies
summary: NetApp CEO George Kurian discusses the company's vision for intelligent data infrastructure and AI integration strategies, emphasizing AI, data unification, and cybersecurity. Key priorities for FY25 include modernizing data centers with flash storage, enhancing security with ransomware protection, and collaborating with hyperscalers for seamless hybrid and multicloud experiences. The strategy centers on bringing AI to data to maximize efficiency and effectiveness, building AI centers of excellence, and offering a unified data platform.

title: After Earnings, Is Arista Stock a Buy, a Sell, or Fairly Valued?
summary: Morningstar significantly raised its fair value estimate for Arista Networks (ANET) to $270 per share, up from $195, driven by strong long-term growth expectations from generative AI and the company's position as a leading provider of high-speed Ethernet networking equipment. While shares were up, Morningstar still views them as slightly overvalued, assigning a 3-star rating, which implies fair valuation compared to their long-term estimate. The company's economic moat is deemed wide due to intangible assets and customer switching costs, with strong financial health and significant growth projected in data centers and campus portfolios, though high customer concentration presents a risk.

title: UWM to House Nation’s First Microsoft AI Lab Focused on Manufacturing – Lubar College of Business
summary: The University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee's Connected Systems Institute will host the nation's first manufacturing-focused AI Co-Innovation Lab, part of Microsoft's $3.3 billion investment in southeast Wisconsin. This lab aims to connect Wisconsin manufacturers with Microsoft's AI experts to design and prototype AI and cloud solutions, targeting 270 Wisconsin companies by 2030, with support from a $500,000 grant from the Wisconsin Economic Development Corporation. The initiative will also establish a TitletownTech office within the lab to support entrepreneurs and startups.

title: Netflix ad-supported tier has 40 million monthly users, nearly double previous count
summary: Netflix's ad-supported tier has reached 40 million global monthly active users, nearly doubling its count since January. This growth comes as Netflix plans to launch its own advertising platform and no longer solely partner with Microsoft for that technology, with 40% of new signups in available countries opting for the cheaper ad-supported plan. The company now has 270 million total subscribers globally.

title: Digimarc Appoints Carle Quinn As Chief People Officer
summary: Digimarc Corporation has appointed Carle Quinn as its new Chief People Officer. Quinn brings over two decades of experience in human capital strategy, having previously served as CPO at Workato, and held key roles at SAP, Citrix, IBM, GE, and QVC. Her role at Digimarc will involve leading the global human resource function, focusing on organizational resilience, performance optimization, and fostering innovation.

title: UBC investments include Qatar, China and Russia
summary: The University of British Columbia's investment subsidiary, UBCIM, holds investments in Russian companies sanctioned by the Canadian government, as well as in Qatari and Chinese entities. This disclosure follows student protests demanding divestment from companies linked to Israel, with the university citing legal and fiduciary obligations for its investment choices. UBCIM manages $5.8 billion in assets and faces scrutiny over its ethical investment practices, particularly concerning Qatar's alleged funding of Hamas and China’s human rights record.

title: Figma Sets $12.5B Valuation in New Equity Offering, Falling Short of Adobe's Acquisition Offer
summary: Figma has announced a tender offer for investors to sell shares at a $12.5 billion valuation, a 25% increase from its 2021 valuation but significantly less than Adobe's terminated $20 billion acquisition offer. The tender offer, expected to range from $600 million to $900 million, is backed by existing and new investors. This development follows the dissolution of the Adobe-Figma acquisition due to regulatory hurdles, highlighting Figma's independent growth despite the failed merger.

title: Netflix plans in-house ad tech, partners with The Trade Desk, Magnite, Google
summary: Netflix is bringing its ad tech in-house by the end of 2025 and expanding its ad buying capabilities through partnerships with The Trade Desk, Magnite, and Google's Display & Video 360. This move coincides with significant growth in its ad-supported subscriber base, now at 40 million monthly active users globally, and aims to enhance advertising measurement and monetization. Analysts view these partnerships as meaningful for The Trade Desk and especially Magnite, expecting future revenue contributions as Netflix scales its programmatic advertising efforts.

summary: The article discusses the recent outperformance of the Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF (DIA) compared to the Nasdaq and S&P 500 over the last month. It suggests this trend indicates investors are becoming more defensive and rebalancing portfolios towards value and income, and away from growth stocks. The author recommends the SPDR Dow Industrial Average ETF as a low-cost option for investors seeking to increase exposure to blue-chip stocks and diversify beyond tech-heavy portfolios.

summary: Amgen, a leading biotechnology company, is leveraging Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 to enhance productivity and foster a more inclusive global workforce. This strategic adoption of AI aims to accelerate drug discovery and development, as well as optimize business processes. Copilot helps Amgen employees manage information, translate content, and streamline data analysis, contributing to faster research and improved operational efficiency in critical areas like manufacturing and R&D.

summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang announced at Dell Technologies World that every company is fundamentally an "intelligence manufacturer," emphasizing generative AI's transformative potential. summary: HP has unveiled new AI PCs, the HP OmniBook X AI PC and HP EliteBook Ultra AI PC, designed with ARM architecture and Snapdragon X Elite processors to power AI experiences locally. summary: H&R Block has launched AI Tax Assist, an AI-powered assistant built using Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI Service, to simplify tax preparation for its online clients. summary: OpenAI has signed a multi-year partnership with News Corp. to use content from its publications, including The Wall Street Journal and New York Post, in its generative AI products. summary: Unum Group utilized Microsoft Azure generative AI solutions, including Azure OpenAI Service and Azure AI Search, to develop a custom AI-powered application. summary: Microsoft and LinkedIn released their 2024 Work Trend Index, revealing that Filipino knowledge workers lead globally and regionally in AI adoption at work. The PCs aim to redefine personal computing by offering features like extended battery life, improved collaboration tools with Poly Camera Pro, and enhanced security with Wolf Pro Security Next Gen Antivirus.

title: JAVS Courtroom Recording Software Backdoored - Deploys RustDoor Malware
summary: Malicious actors have backdoored the installer for Justice AV Solutions (JAVS) courtroom video recording software to distribute malware known as RustDoor, a supply chain attack tracked as CVE-2024-4978. The compromised installer, JAVS Viewer v8.3.7, was signed with an unexpected Authenticode signature, leading to the deployment of a malicious executable that contacts a command-and-control server and attempts to gather credentials. JAVS has acknowledged a "potential security issue," pulled the affected version, and advised users to check for indicators of compromise and re-image affected systems.

The couple is also planning a pre-wedding celebration on a cruise to Italy.

title: M&T Bank Taps Rich Data Co for AI Decisioning Platform
summary: Rich Data Co (RDC) has partnered with M&T Bank Corp. to deploy its AI decisioning platform, marking RDC's first U.S. customer. M&T Bank, the sixth-largest commercial bank in North America, will leverage the AI platform to enhance insights into cash flow, credit risk, and lending opportunities, and improve its risk management strategies. This collaboration, facilitated by reseller nCino, demonstrates the growing trend of AI shaping the financial services sector, particularly in small and medium-sized business lending.

title: When You Should Consider Fundamentally Weighted ETFs
summary: This article discusses fundamentally weighted ETFs as a contrarian investment strategy, comparing them to market-cap-weighted value ETFs. It explains how these ETFs use metrics like operating cash flow, sales, and book value to size positions instead of market capitalization, thereby reflecting a company's economic footprint. The article highlights the "buy-low, sell-high" mechanism of fundamentally weighted ETFs and how it limits exposure to richly valued stocks while tilting towards cheaper, quality stocks.

title: OpenAI signs ‘landmark’ deal with News Corp
summary: OpenAI has entered into a multi-year partnership with News Corp, gaining access to current and archived content from numerous publications including The Wall Street Journal and The Sun. This collaboration aims to provide users with reliable information and news sources. The deal emphasizes upholding high journalistic standards and acknowledges the commercial and social significance of journalism in the digital age.

title: Lexicon Pharmaceuticals Selects Medidata Solutions to Help Advance PROGRESS Study
summary: Lexicon Pharmaceuticals has chosen Medidata Solutions to advance its PROGRESS study, a Phase 2b trial for LX9211 in diabetic peripheral neuropathic pain (DPNP). Medidata's Decentralized Clinical Trial (DCT) solutions, utilizing AI and automation, will help accelerate patient enrollment and remote monitoring. This collaboration aims to bring LX9211, a potential first new non-opioid drug for neuropathic pain in over two decades, to diabetic patients faster.

title: Responding to growing demand, Duke Energy, Amazon, Google, Microsoft and Nucor execute agreements to accelerate clean energy options
summary: Duke Energy, in collaboration with Amazon, Google, Microsoft, and Nucor, announced agreements to develop innovative approaches for carbon-free energy generation and meet the future energy needs of large businesses in North and South Carolina. These agreements, detailed in Memorandums of Understanding, propose new rate structures called "Accelerating Clean Energy (ACE) tariffs" and a "Clean Transition Tariff (CTT)" to lower the long-term costs of clean energy technologies and accelerate grid decarbonization. These voluntary programs are designed to facilitate direct support for clean energy investments, enabling customers with large-scale energy needs to achieve their sustainability goals while ensuring protections for non-participating customers.

title: Artificial Intelligence ETFs: Have They Beaten The Market In 2024?
summary: This article examines the performance of major Artificial Intelligence (AI) ETFs—BOTZ, AIQ, and ROBO—in 2024 against the broader market represented by the S&P 500. While BOTZ and AIQ showed positive year-to-date returns of 10.63% and 10.33% respectively, and benefited from holdings in companies like NVIDIA, the ROBO ETF underperformed with a 0.94% decline. Crucially, none of these AI ETFs managed to surpass the S&P 500's 11.46% appreciation, largely due to the S&P 500's significant weight in top-performing tech giants.

title: Rising commercial PC sales help HP beat earnings and revenue targets
summary: HP Inc. surpassed its earnings and revenue targets, driven by a recovery in the global PC market and increasing commercial PC sales. title: Anthony Denier, President of Webull - Building a $7Bn Disruptor, Expanding US Markets Access Globally, What Makes a Great Trader
summary: This article features an interview with Anthony Denier, Group President of Webull, a $7 billion global investment platform. Denier discusses Webull's rapid expansion, its strategy for providing international investors access to US markets, and his perspective on the qualities of a successful trader. He also elaborates on Webull's decision to go public via SPAC and the evolution of the trading industry due to technology and regulations.

title: Turtle Beach has ended its partnership with Dr Disrespect
summary: Turtle Beach has terminated its partnership with streamer Guy ‘Dr Disrespect’ Beahm following recent allegations that he was banned from Twitch for sexting a minor. This move follows Midnight Society, a game development studio co-founded by Beahm, also cutting ties with him over these new claims. Although Twitch never publicly stated the reason for his 2020 ban, a former employee's recent post on X provided the alleged details, which The Verge subsequently corroborated.

title: Progress Software elevates severity of new MOVEit bug to ‘critical’ as exploit attempts jump
summary: Progress Software has elevated a new MOVEit vulnerability (CVE-2024-5806) to "critical" severity, urging customers to patch the issue due to increased exploitation attempts. The bug, resembling a previous vulnerability, allows hackers to access and manipulate data on MOVEit Transfer servers, leading to widespread concern among cybersecurity researchers and government agencies. This comes after a 2023 incident involving a similar MOVEit vulnerability resulted in massive data theft affecting millions and numerous lawsuits against Progress Software.

title: CSN deploys Company Communicator and reaches 35,000 users with its corporate communication using Microsoft 365
summary: CSN, a Brazilian multinational company, partnered with Microsoft to implement Microsoft 365, significantly expanding its licensing and improving internal communication. Through the Company Communicator app, branded as CSNews, CSN now reaches 35,000 users, including frontline workers, with customizable, monitored, and constantly updated corporate communications. This digital transformation has enhanced communication agility, efficiency, and security, with future plans to integrate more security features.

title: The A.I. Boom Has an Unlikely Early Winner: Wonky Consultants (Published 2024)
summary: Consulting firms like Boston Consulting Group, McKinsey, KPMG, IBM, and Accenture are experiencing a significant boom due to companies seeking guidance on adopting generative AI. These firms are cashing in on the need for expertise in integrating AI, with some seeing a fifth of their revenue now coming from AI-related work. Despite some challenges and "hallucinations" encountered with early AI implementations, the demand for consulting services to navigate the new technology is strong, reminiscent of the dot-com era.

title: What Exactly Does NVIDIA Do, and Why Should You Care?
summary: This article provides an introduction to NVIDIA, highlighting its transformation from a GPU manufacturer to a systems company offering hardware and an ecosystem for developers. It delves into the factors driving NVIDIA's success, its significant impact on the customer experience market through AI, and key partnerships with companies like Cisco, SAP, and ServiceNow. The piece emphasizes NVIDIA's role in advancing AI for personalized and intelligent customer interactions across various sectors.

title: CNH boosts customer loyalty with Microsoft Dynamics 365
summary: CNH Industrial, a global leader in agriculture and construction equipment, has enhanced customer loyalty and operational efficiency by adopting Microsoft Dynamics 365. The company standardized its CRM systems across various brands and sales functions, improving sales predictions, customer interactions, and dealer collaboration. This strategic move transformed CRM from a mere tool into a core business strategy, and CNH plans to expand its Dynamics 365 implementation globally while exploring new features to further improve lead nurturing and performance.

title: Global E-learning Market Size To Worth USD 1515.97 Billion By 2033 | CAGR of 17.35%
summary: The global E-learning Market is projected to grow from USD 305.97 Billion in 2023 to USD 1515.97 Billion by 2033, exhibiting a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 17.35%. This growth is driven by increasing internet connectivity, technological advancements like AI and VR, and the expanding need for online learning solutions across academic, corporate, and government sectors. North America is expected to hold the largest market share, while Asia Pacific anticipates the fastest growth.

title: Conagra partners working on AI solutions
summary: Conagra Brands Inc. has partnered with Microsoft and Ernst & Young (EY) to implement AI solutions aimed at improving operational efficiencies across various departments. These collaborations focus on leveraging generative AI and intelligent automation to streamline processes, enhance decision-making, and support product innovation and marketing efforts, all while prioritizing a human-centered approach to AI strategy.

title: Why Blue Chips Are Ripe for Growth Investing
summary: The article discusses why blue-chip companies are attractive for growth investing, particularly through the Fidelity Blue Chip Growth ETF (FBCG). Sonu Kalra, FBCG's portfolio manager, highlights the compelling time for growth stocks due to an innovation cycle, emphasizing that many large companies are also highly innovative. He details FBCG's strategy of investing in companies with sustainable business models, strong earnings growth, and competitive advantages, focusing on themes like artificial intelligence and health and wellness.

title: A Shakeup for Technology ETFs
summary: The Technology Select Sector SPDR Fund (XLK) recently underwent a significant rebalance, swapping a large position in Apple for Nvidia. This rebalance highlights the complexities of index rules, particularly the RIC diversification test, and its impact on ETF holdings. The article discusses how passive indexing can sometimes appear active due to various exceptions and weighting methodologies, influencing ETF performance and investor perceptions.

title: Potential BlackRock withdrawal could hit Malaysia’s investment and job market, says Tengku Zafrul
summary: Minister of Investment, Trade and Industry Datuk Seri Tengku Zafrul Aziz warned that a BlackRock Inc withdrawal from Malaysia would significantly impact the country's investment and job market. He highlighted that BlackRock holds shares in major multinational companies like Microsoft, Boeing, and Intel which have substantial investments and job creation in Malaysia. Tengku Zafrul clarified that while the ministry deals with these operating companies, it does not have direct dealings with their shareholders, including BlackRock.

title: The Case for Investing in a Capital Appreciation ETF
summary: The T. Rowe Price Capital Appreciation ETF (TCAF) has shown rapid growth since its launch in June 2023, accumulating $1.7 billion in assets. This active ETF focuses on U.S. large-cap equities with a bottom-up stock selection approach, seeking attractive valuations and strong management. Managed by award-winning portfolio manager David Giroux, TCAF aims to capitalize on market opportunities through fundamental analysis and may be particularly advantageous in a period of anticipated interest rate divergence.

title: Wipro chairman Rishad Premji to shareholders: Uniting … is at the core of Wipro
summary: Wipro Chairman Rishad Premji has addressed shareholders, emphasizing that uniting employees, clients, shareholders, partners, and communities is central to the company's ethos. He highlighted Wipro's significant investment in AI, training over 225,000 employees in GenAI fundamentals and 30,000 in advanced skills, viewing AI as a crucial element for long-term value creation and industry transformation. Premji also expressed confidence in new CEO Srini Pallia's leadership, despite a challenging FY24 which saw a revenue decrease but an increase in net income and strong operating cash flow.

title: ASE to open US testing fab next month
summary: ASE Technology Holding Co, the world's largest chip packaging and testing service provider, is set to open a new high-end chip testing fab in the US next month, specifically targeting its North American AI customers. This move is part of ASE's larger global expansion strategy, which includes scouting locations in Japan and Mexico, to meet customer demands for stronger supply chain resilience amidst geopolitical concerns. The company also raised its revenue forecast for advanced packaging technology due to strong demand for AI chips.

title: 12 Common Concerns of the Permeable IoT Attack Surface
summary: This article outlines 12 common security concerns associated with the expanding Internet of Things (IoT) attack surface. It highlights issues such as limited device updates, lack of standardization, data privacy, and supply chain vulnerabilities, emphasizing the unique challenges IoT presents compared to traditional systems. The author advocates for a DevSecOps approach to embed security from the initial stages of development and operations, using automation to address the rapidly growing and diverse IoT ecosystem.

title: 3 ETFs to Buy for Nvidia Stock Dominance
summary: This article recommends three ETFs for investors seeking exposure to Nvidia's continued dominance in the tech and AI sectors. The ETFs highlighted are the Technology Select Sector SPDR Fund (XLK) for its high Nvidia concentration, the VanEck Robotics ETF (IBOT) for a broader automation play with lighter Nvidia weighting, and the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) for comprehensive semiconductor market exposure, also heavily weighted towards Nvidia. These options cater to investors looking to capitalize on Nvidia's growth while potentially dampening volatility through diversification.

title: 5 Stocks to Buy for 3Q 2024
summary: Morningstar Chief US Markets Strategist Dave Sekera discusses the Q3 2024 stock and bond market outlook and recommends five stocks for the quarter: ExxonMobil, Fortinet, International Flavors and Fragrances, Baxter International, and Ventas Inc. He also reviews recent earnings reports, key economic data, and Morningstar's fair value estimates for several companies, including Taiwan Semiconductor and Chipotle. The discussion highlights concerns about consumer spending, market concentration in large-cap tech stocks, and opportunities in undervalued sectors like small-cap and value stocks.

title: Active investing is suited to the uncertain markets ahead
summary: The article argues that changing market conditions, characterized by higher rates, greater dispersion, and heightened volatility, will favor active investing over passive strategies. While passive investing saw significant growth in recent decades, primarily due to low interest rates and index concentration, narrowing fee gaps and the rise of active ETFs suggest a shift in the investment landscape. Active managers with strong research capabilities are expected to thrive by identifying opportunities in a more discerning market.

title: Active investing is suited to the uncertain markets ahead
summary: This article argues that active investing is well-suited for the current market environment characterized by higher rates, greater dispersion, and heightened volatility, a shift from the post-GFC era that favored passive strategies. It highlights the narrowing fee gap between active and passive funds and the rise of active ETFs as factors contributing to this shift. The author believes skilled active managers with global scale and deep research platforms are better positioned to outperform in these changing conditions, despite the past dominance of passive funds driven by highly concentrated markets.

title: Amdocs says its GenAI is ready to move on from PoC stage
summary: Amdocs' CMO Gil Rosen states that the company's amAIz platform, which uses telecom-specific data to adapt large language models (LLMs) for the telecom industry, is ready for customer deployment and outperforms human customer service agents. The platform, which has minimized hallucinations, is currently transitioning from proof-of-concept to production, with a focus on improving cost efficiency and performance for telcos. Rosen indicates that major tech companies like Nvidia, Microsoft, AWS, and Google have partnered with Amdocs for their telecom go-to-market strategies due to Amdocs' expertise in connecting customer information systems to LLMs.

title: 13 Charts On the Market’s Q2 Turnaround
summary: The article provides a detailed analysis of the market's performance in Q2 2024, highlighting a turnaround despite initial inflation worries. It emphasizes that stocks rebounded due to improving inflation data and strong earnings, with megacap tech and AI stocks, particularly Nvidia, driving the gains. The Federal Reserve's anticipated interest rate cuts in September also contributed to positive sentiment in both stock and bond markets.

title: Redfin, Zillow named in video privacy lawsuits
summary: Redfin and Zillow are facing two separate class-action lawsuits filed in California, alleging violations of video privacy laws. The lawsuits claim the real estate companies shared consumers' personally identifiable data, including names and email addresses, with third-party firms like Meta and Alphabet after users viewed agent-created video home tours. The plaintiff is seeking class-action status, punitive damages, and orders to prevent further unauthorized disclosure of consumer data.

title: Microsoft Recognizes Wipro for Advanced Endpoint Management Specialization
summary: Wipro has achieved Microsoft's Modernize Endpoints Advanced Specialization, marking its 16th such recognition from Microsoft. This accomplishment highlights Wipro's expertise in securing modern workplaces, managing access to corporate resources across various devices, and supporting hybrid work environments. The specialization underscores Wipro's ability to meet stringent Microsoft requirements and deliver effective solutions for cybersecurity and endpoint management.
